say:3:1120309001:1.text: For someone who was lying dead on the ground a second ago, you sure seem full of energy.
say:3:1120309001:1.source_cn: ……你这不是精神的很吗，刚刚还在地上装，现在马上就能跳...

say:4:1120309002:1.text: I was worried that something actually happened to you!
say:4:1120309002:1.source_cn: 就是！亏我还真以为你怎么了呢……

say:5:1120309003:0.text: Well, as you all know by now, my line of work is not an easy one.
say:5:1120309003:0.source_cn: 啊呀，两位勇者大人，魔法师大人，小仓鼠大人，你们也都知...
say:5:1120309003:0.male: Well, as you all know by now, my line of work is not an easy one.
say:5:1120309003:0.female: Well, as you all know by now, my line of work is not an easy one.

say:7:1120309004:1.text: Aside from woefully slim profits, I'm also under constant attack by revenge-seeking ruffians and the like. That's why it helps to have a few emergency escape tactics under my belt!
say:7:1120309004:1.source_cn: 不仅利润微薄，还容易结仇，动不动就被人喊打喊杀的。所以...

say:8:1120309005:1.text: Does it really count as "escaping" if you just lie on the ground like that?
say:8:1120309005:1.source_cn: ……就地躺倒这种方式，真的能让你“逃生”吗？

say:9:1120309006:1.text: You may not know it, but feigning death is a time-honored meerkat skill passed down from generation to generation... Eh, I've said too much.
say:9:1120309006:1.source_cn: 这你可就有所不知了，这招可是我们的传统技能……啊呀，不...

say:10:1120309007:1.text: So, what can I do for you, my friends?
say:10:1120309007:1.source_cn: 所以，各位大人们这次大驾光临，是有什么事情吗？

say:11:1120309008:1.text: We came to ask for your help.

choice_prompt:12:1120309008.text: We came to ask for your help.

say:13:1120309009:1.text: There's a very sick Mauler child who needs your help. At first, I thought he just had a cold, but his symptoms didn't stop worsening.
say:13:1120309009:1.source_cn: 是这样的，阿熏。我们族里有个孩子生病了，原本以为是普通...

say:14:1120309010:1.text: I gave him every herb I knew of in an attempt to cure him, but nothing worked at all. If anything, his condition is still deteriorating...
say:14:1120309010:1.source_cn: 我给她用了我知道的所有能缓解症状的草药，但是她却完全没...

say:15:1120309011:1.text: Just when we thought we were out of options, we remembered you... You're the one who saved my life back at the Warsong Festival!
say:15:1120309011:1.source_cn: 我们实在走投无路了，就想到了你……之前战歌节上，就是你...

say:16:1120309012:1.text: I've heard so much about your medical expertise and your potion-crafting skills... Would you please come back with us to the Uru Clan and treat this poor boy?
say:16:1120309012:1.source_cn: 听说你特别擅长制药，而且医术高超……求求你了，能不能和...

say:17:1120309013:1.text: So you want me to help with a sick child...
say:17:1120309013:1.source_cn: 原来你们来，是为了给孩子寻求帮助……

say:18:1120309014:1.text: *Sigh* I'm all too familiar with this sort of thing. After all, there are plenty of children in my family...
say:18:1120309014:1.source_cn: 唉，说到这个孩子，我可太清楚了。我家孩子也多得很……

say:19:1120309015:1.text: And taking care of even one of them is no easy feat. They can be so fragile sometimes... Oops, there I go rambling again!
say:19:1120309015:1.source_cn: 照顾孩子真不是一件容易事，动不动就冷了热了饿了……啊，...

say:20:1120309016:1.text: What I mean to say is that I'll gladly lend a hand! I just need to take a close look at the boy, and I'll know exactly what he needs.
say:20:1120309016:1.source_cn: 我其实是想说，你放心，这忙我一定帮！区区小病，我看几眼...

say:22:1120309018:1.text: But before that, please give me a moment. I still have some matters to discuss with Meerky.
say:22:1120309018:1.source_cn: 不过在那之前，还有劳各位稍等片刻。我有些事情要和蒙蒙交...

narration:28:1120326001:0.text: Smokey explains something to Meerky in great detail...
narration:28:1120326001:0.source_cn: 阿熏对着蒙蒙交代了一番……
